{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk sheath dress, empire waist cut, midi length, midnight blue (#191970), crepe de chine.
Cashmere-blend bolero jacket, relaxed fit, cropped length at the hip, charcoal grey (#36454F), fine wool blend.
Stiletto pumps, pointed toe, ankle height, burgundy (#800020), patent leather.
Pearl drop earrings, 15 mm diameter, white, cultured freshwater pearl and sterling silver.
This ensemble perfectly balances the formal requirements of an upscale wedding dinner with your specific wishes to avoid strict business suits. The midnight blue dress offers a sophisticated alternative to traditional black while the charcoal bolero adds necessary structure without feeling like office wear. Choosing burgundy pumps and pearls introduces a touch of festive warmth that complements the autumn evening atmosphere inside the restaurant."}
